findings.evidence: Diffractive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:63 `def delta (K : DisKinematics V) : V := K.p - K.pPrime` vs Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64 `def delta (K : ExclKinematics V) : V := K.pPrime - K.p`.
findings.fix: Keep the sign (the roadmap fixes it) but give it a distinguishing name, e.g. `deltaTarget` (and `deltaTarget_def`, `deltaTarget_congr`), so neither `delta` silently reads as the other convention.
findings.issue: `delta K = K.p - K.pPrime`, but the sibling `DIS.Exclusive.Kinematics.ExclKinematics.delta` is `K.pPrime - K.p`. Same name, same physical quantity, opposite sign, in two namespaces of the same DIS subtree; the sign is invisible in `xi`'s and `MX2`'s statements, where it matters (`tMom` is sign-blind, hence the author's own `tMom_eq_pPrime_sub_p_sq`).

findings.evidence: Lines 87/167: `xi_def : xi g K = g (delta K) K.q / g K.p K.q` and `xi_eq_div : xi g K = (...) / (...)`; lines 100/120 and 106/134 for the `MX2`/`MY2` `_def` vs `_eq` pairs; `beta_eq_Q2_div` (line 154) shows the author's own more descriptive pattern.
findings.fix: Name from the conclusion: `xi_eq_Q2_add_MX2_sub_tMom_div_Q2_add_W2_sub_p_sq` (or shorter but RHS-bearing), `MX2_eq_two_mul_apply_delta_q_sub_Q2_add_tMom`, `MY2_eq_p_sq_sub_two_mul_apply_p_delta_add_tMom`, `two_mul_apply_delta_q_eq_Q2_add_MX2_sub_tMom`. Note the repo spells `g a b` as `apply` in names (`ExclKinematics.neg_delta_apply_q_add_qPrime`, `Tensors/Longitudinal.lean:220 apply_pTransverse_self`), which `two_mul_delta_q_eq` drops — the PR description itself calls it `two_mul_apply_delta_q`.
findings.issue: `xi_eq_div` names no part of its conclusion — `xi_def` (line 87) is already an equation with a division, so `_div` distinguishes nothing. Same defect at lines 120 (`MX2_eq`) and 134 (`MY2_eq`), each of which is the non-trivial expansion while the bare-`_def` lemma (lines 100, 106) is the actual definitional equation, and at line 128 (`two_mul_delta_q_eq`).

summary: Two naming problems: `delta` duplicates the name of the sibling exclusive-kinematics `delta` with the opposite sign, and several lemmas carry bare `_eq`/`_div` suffixes that do not describe their conclusion and collide conceptually with the `_def` lemma for the same quantity.
